def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and all(grid[r][c] != 3 for r in range(h)))
    line = next(r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]))
    bg = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (3, grid[line][0], grid[0][sep]))

    def groups(n, sep_positions):
        out, start = [], 0
        for p in sep_positions:
            out.append((start, p))
            start = p + 1
        out.append((start, n))
        return out

    rows = groups(h, [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])])
    cols = groups(w, [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))])
    counts = [[sum(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(a, b) for c in range(x, y))
               for x, y in cols] for a, b in rows]
    m = max(map(max, counts))
    return [[1 if counts[i][j] == m and m > 0 else bg for j in range(len(cols))]
            for i in range(len(rows))]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Solid separator rows and columns divide the grid into blocks.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def intervals(n, separators):
        result = []
        start = 0
        for p in separators:
            if p >= start:
                if p > start:
                    result.append((start, p))
                start = p + 1
        if start < n:
            result.append((start, n))
        return result

    row_blocks = intervals(h, sep_rows)
    col_blocks = intervals(w, sep_cols)

    mark = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in
                (grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else -1,))
    background = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (mark,) and
                      v not in {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} and
                      v not in {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols})

    counts = [
        [sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
         for c0, c1 in col_blocks]
        for r0, r1 in row_blocks
    ]
    maximum = max(max(row) for row in counts)
    return [[1 if value == maximum and maximum > 0 else background for value in row]
            for row in counts]

    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    separator = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]]

    def blocks(size, separators):
        result, start = [], 0
        for p in separators:
            if p > start:
                result.append((start, p))
            start = p + 1
        if start < size:
            result.append((start, size))
        return result

    rb = blocks(h, sep_rows)
    cb = blocks(w, sep_cols)

    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}

         for c0, c1 in cb]
        for r0, r1 in rb

    maximum = max(max(row) for row in counts)
